The fourteen recorded stage triples, both recorded kappas, all fourteen headrooms and the twelve published membership margins are reproduced exactly from this input path. The card's remaining obligation therefore narrows to the sigma/stock-coefficient sentence (the stock audit's open question 1), which this note states with the exact per-stage headrooms but does not discharge.

stop_rule: Stop after the source-location facts, the fourteen-stage byte-level reproduction, the kappa/headroom bindings, the twelve membership margins from this input path, and the six mutation controls. evidence: Exact rational arithmetic on the SHA-256-bound selected receipt plus source facts asserted against the pinned upstream1087.tar.gz member code/assemble.py: (1) exactly one cuts.append site and one outer_witness definition, called exactly twice (conservative line 221, native line 226); (2) s = min(c,(1-beta)*bb) - 10^-27 equals (1-beta)*complex_lower - 10^-27 for both branches because (1-beta)*complex_lower < bit_lower holds exactly; (3) all fourteen recorded (exponent, gap, cutoff_log2) triples byte-match the recomputed chain, with the assembler's inline cutoff guard true at every stage; (4) the frozen rounding formula reproduces kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 and conservative_kappa = 104541262139063/62500000000000000 exactly from their own chains; (5) all fourteen recomputed headrooms match the audited stock_headroom_log2 (stage 1 = 6562783 both branches) and satisfy 2(H+4) <= L*delta < 2(H+5); (6) the twelve published stock-margin-chain membership margins and routing rooms are reproduced from the receipt's own records. Six controls rejected: bit-driven chain, branch swap, tampered cutoff, stale-cutoff substitution, cross-branch kappa, headroom identity. All recorded actual_stock_coefficient fields are null.
